subject: minor refactoring
reason: The change is a pure refactor: it renames BloomFilterType2 to BloomFilterType and BLOOM_FILTER_TYPE2 to BLOOM_FILTER_TYPE (Rust identifiers only — the RedisType name string "bloomtype" and encoding version 0 are unchanged, so RDB and TYPE behaviour are identical), replaces the string literal "ERROR" with the pre-existing constant ERROR whose value is the same "ERROR" string, and replaces Ok(RedisValue::SimpleStringStatic("OK")) with REDIS_OK, which is defined as exactly that value. Every reply, error message, serialized byte and callback behaviour is byte-identical on both builds, so no comman
